verdict.rationale: This story describes an agent visually verifying its own code changes by driving an app and taking before-and-after screenshots, which is a coding-agent or browser-automation capability. Jira is an issue and project-tracking product, so the question is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira shipping such a feature, including its Rovo AI automations and its official MCP server, so the exception does not apply.
